content:
A non-mandate trace at READY reports `intended_account_id`, transmission reference and amount. The current incoming `account_id` remains the book entry; the two can differ.

Mandate-based advice uses `mandate_id` and bank value time instead of a direct destination field. Its entitlement is established by dated SIGNED claims. A trace does not itself reverse a posting or release its source reservation.
